mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO draw_request ( request_id, user_id, activity_id, status, execution_token, execution_time, result_payload, completed_time, created_time, updated_time ) VALUES ( #{request.requestId}, #{request.userId}, #{request.activityId}, #{request.status}, #{request.executionToken}, #{request.executionTime}, #{request.resultPayload}, #{request.completedTime}, #{request.createdTime}, #{request.updatedTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT request_id, user_id, activity_id, status, execution_token, execution_time, result_payload, completed_time, created_time, updated_time FROM draw_request WHERE request_id = #{requestId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT draw_request_row.request_id FROM draw_request draw_request_row WHERE ( draw_request_row.status = 0 AND draw_request_row.execution_time IS NOT NULL AND draw_request_row.execution_time <= #{executionCutoff} ) OR ( draw_request_row.status = 2 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM draw_resource_reservation reservation WHERE reservation.request_id = draw_request_row.request_id AND reservation.status IN (0, 1) AND ( reservation.next_retry_time IS NULL OR reservation.next_retry_time <= #{now} ) ) ) OR ( draw_request_row.status = 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM draw_resource_reservation reservation WHERE reservation.request_id = draw_request_row.request_id AND reservation.status = 3 AND reservation.terminalized_time IS NULL AND ( reservation.next_retry_time IS NULL OR reservation.next_retry_time <= #{now} ) ) ) ORDER BY draw_request_row.updated_time, draw_request_row.request_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT draw_request_row.request_id, draw_request_row.user_id, draw_request_row.activity_id, draw_request_row.status, draw_request_row.execution_token, draw_request_row.execution_time, draw_request_row.result_payload, draw_request_row.completed_time, draw_request_row.created_time, draw_request_row.updated_time FROM draw_request AS draw_request_row WHERE draw_request_row.user_id = #{userId} AND draw_request_row.activity_id = #{activityId} AND ( draw_request_row.status = 0 OR ( draw_request_row.status = 2 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM draw_resource_reservation AS reservation WHERE reservation.request_id = draw_request_row.request_id AND reservation.status NOT IN (2, 4) ) ) ) ORDER BY draw_request_row.updated_time DESC, draw_request_row.request_id DESC LIMIT 1
